correctness.rationale: Q5 has 32 vertices/80 edges. The defining third-edge conflict predicate and equivalent bit-distance predicate agree on all 3160 pairs; conflict graph has 1120 pairs, degree28. Edge-transitivity reduces any 13-packing to a 12-clique in the 51-vertex compatibility graph after a fixed cube edge. Independent NetworkX maximal-clique enumeration over that graph found 0 cliques of order12, exactly 12 of order11 and a maximum of 11. The 12-edge four-star construction has no conflicting pair and orbit under 32 translations/120 coordinate permutations has size80; fixed-edge double count 80*12/12=80. The search is exhaustive finite proof for Q5 only.
